title: Levels fixed header
description: A 73px near-black bar at 85% with a blur, fixed over the top of the page: tracked-capital wordmark on the left, four quiet white nav items centred (one opening a small dropdown on hover), a Login link and a small white button on the right. Phones get a round outlined menu button that opens a dark panel. Links brighten from 80% to full white over 150ms.
notes: position: fixed, so it overlays whatever comes first (the hero leaves room for it); pass className="sticky" to keep it in flow
it is a .dark scope: white text and button in both modes
the phone menu and the dropdown are CSS only (details element and hover)
